items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued November 17 at 3:47AM PST until November 18 at 4:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...An increased risk for sneaker waves and strong rip
currents with breaking waves of 13 to 17 ft expected.

* WHERE...Pacific Coast beaches.

* WHEN...Through 4 PM PST Wednesday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Waves can sweep across the shoreline without
warning, pulling people into the sea from beaches, jetties,
and rocks.
items.instruction:
Stay off of jetties, piers, rocks, and other waterside
infrastructure. Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous surf
and NEVER turn your back on the ocean. Monitor local weather,
surf and tide forecasts at www.weather.gov/mtr.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 16 at 1:40PM PST until November 18 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...The Pacific Coast.

* WHEN...From 9 PM Tuesday to 1 PM PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 17 at 3:12AM PST until November 17 at 9:00AM PST by NWS San Francisco CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Small Craft Advisory, seas 7 to 12 ft. For the
Gale Warning, south winds 20 to 30 kt with gusts up to 40 kt
expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Waters from Point Reyes to Pigeon Point
California out to 10 NM.

* WHEN...For the Small Craft Advisory, until 9 AM PST this
morning. For the Gale Warning, from 9 PM this evening to 3 AM
PST Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds will cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should alter plans to avoid these hazardous conditions.
Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter course, and/or secure the
vessel for hazardous conditions.
